note: Every Kalshi futures market the simulator compares against, mapped to one exact simulated outcome from its settlement rules. Generated by simulator/src/cli/build_kalshi_mappings.ts from the markets Kalshi's public API returned to .github/workflows/simulator-sources.yml (NFL: GitHub Actions run 39952027751; MLB and NHL: run 40019030435; all 2026-10-23; mapping_version names each sport's run): a market is mapped only when its rules match its series' template word for word, name the club its ticker and label name, carry nothing beyond Kalshi's standard disclaimer, and its series is the quadratic fee type with multiplier 1. A market that is not listed here is never compared; one whose rules change is excluded by the rules sha256 check until it is mapped again.

thresholds.note: max_reference_spread follows public.kalshi_rule('max_spread') (0.06). A flag needs a fresh quote, a verified mapping, the ask size at exec_quantity, a verified fee schedule, an executable edge of at least min_exec_edge_pp points and at least min_edge_mcse_multiple Monte Carlo SEs.

fees.formula: fee per order = ceil_to_cent(rate x contracts x P x (1 - P)), P the price in dollars: Kalshi's quadratic model fee 0.07 x M x C x P x (1 - P) with M = fee_multiplier = 1 for every mapped series, rounded up to the cent (exact on a non-direct, FCM-cleared member's $0.01 balance grid; an upper bound, by less than $0.01 per order, on a direct member's $0.0001 grid)
fees.source: https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/fee_rounding (worked example: a model fee of $0.00363825 on a $0.055 buy = 0.07 x 0.055 x 0.945; fees rounded to the member's balance grid) and https://docs.kalshi.com/openapi.yaml (fee_type 'quadratic' and 'quadratic_with_maker_fees' follow the General Trading Fees Table; fee_multiplier). Every mapped series is quadratic or quadratic_with_maker_fees with fee_multiplier 1 (Kalshi API /series); no mapped event carries a fee override and no fee change is scheduled (/events/{ticker}, /series/fee_changes): GitHub Actions run 39952027751 (NFL) and run 40019030435 (MLB: the mapped series KXMLB is quadratic_with_maker_fees x1, its event KXMLB-26 carries no override, no fee change is scheduled; build_kalshi_mappings.ts leaves out a series of any other fee type) and the same run for the NHL (KXNHL, KXNHLEAST and KXNHLWEST quadratic_with_maker_fees x1, the division, Presidents' Trophy and playoff series quadratic x1, no event override, no fee change scheduled). kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf answered the runner with a 429 challenge page.
